summary: Iteration 8: Draft Fill-ins. All 5 requested flows PASS. (1) Guest demo, then Send on Beta Corp: the Claude draft reads 'Tier 2 is [price]...'. draft-fillins shows the chip [price] and draft-send-button reads 'Fill 1 blank to send' and is disabled. (2) Clicking the chip focuses the textarea and selects exactly '[price]'. Typing replaces it, the chips disappear, and the button reads 'Send' and is enabled. Pluralisation is right: 'Fill 3 blanks to send', then 'Fill 2 blanks to send'. draft-fillin-1 selects the second placeholder. (3) Send gives the toast 'Demo: marked as sent (no real email went out)'. The modal closes and the Beta card is removed. The DB/GET draft body holds the edited text. (4) The backend guard returns 400 'Fill in every [placeholder] before sending.' both with no body (original draft) and with a body containing [price]. No sends doc is written and the item stays in the top list. (5) A body without placeholders sends right away ('simulated'). It also works in the UI after clearing the placeholders. Backend 8/9 tests pass. The one failure is a real bug: the body of a draft that was already sent can still be overwritten.

minor.issue: service.send changes and saves the draft body BEFORE it checks for an existing send. Re-POSTing to a sent draft with {body:'edited [x]'} overwrote the saved body, so GET now shows 'edited [x]' and not the text that was sent. In live mode this path also creates a new Gmail draft and deletes the old one for an email that was already sent. Fix: check db.sends (return 'already_sent') before editing, or skip edits when a sends doc exists.

When the body still contains a [placeholder], the edit is saved (and in live mode a new Gmail draft is created) before the 400. This is acceptable as an autosave, but run the placeholder check first if that side effect is not wanted.

action_items: In advisor/service.py send(): return 'already_sent' before applying body edits, so sent drafts cannot be rewritten and Gmail drafts are not recreated

Update the stale regression test tests/test_advisor_guest_api.py::test_draft_and_send_once. It still asserts 'Template draft' in the body and sends with no body, which now returns 400 because Claude drafts contain [price]. Send a filled body instead.
critical_code_review_comments: The PLACEHOLDER regex is duplicated in the frontend (DraftModal.jsx) and the backend (service.py). It is the same pattern now, but keep them in sync.
DraftModal: chip keys use match index. This is fine. The textarea has no maxLength, so the backend's 5000 limit returns 422 and the user only sees a generic toast.
test_credentials: Guest only; no Clerk auth exercised this iteration
seed_data_creation: Temporary guest sessions; the pytest ones were cleaned up and the browser guest sessions were left in place
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_draft_fillins.py. test_resend_after_sent_with_placeholder should pass once send() checks sends before editing. The Claude Beta draft reliably contains [price].
rca of the issue: Repro: send a draft with a filled body (200 simulated), then POST again with {body:'edited [x]'}. The response is 400 (placeholder), but the body is already updated in db.drafts because the edit block runs before both the placeholder check and the sends duplicate check.
